## 📌 Description
Final production‑ready release including thorough documentation, code refactoring, CI/CD hardening, a complete sample test suite, and a signed GitHub release.

## ✅ Tasks
- [ ] **Code Freeze & Refactoring**
- Remove all `TODO`s and dead code
- Standardise naming across all utilities, page objects, and tests
- Ensure Checkstyle, SpotBugs (optional) pass with zero violations

- [ ] **Documentation**
- Update `README.md` with full setup guide, architecture diagram, and examples
- Write `CONTRIBUTING.md` and `CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md`
- Generate Javadoc for public APIs

- [ ] **Sample Test Suite**
- Cover at least 5 end‑to‑end scenarios using all framework features (POM, data‑driven, visual, parallel, retry)
- Provide a `smoke-testng.xml` for quick validation

- [ ] **CI/CD Final Polish**
- All workflows must be green on `main` and `dev`
- `release-pr.yml` fully tested – creates signed tag, GitHub Release, and bumps `dev` to next SNAPSHOT
- Add badge to README showing build status

- [ ] **Performance Baseline**
- Run a benchmark (e.g., 20 tests parallel) – record average execution time
- Ensure no memory leaks (Playwright browsers are properly closed)

- [ ] **Signed Release**
- Tag `v1.0.0` signed with GPG
- GitHub Release with auto‑generated changelog from merged PRs

## 🔍 Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] New user can clone, run `mvn test`, and see passing tests within 5 minutes
- [ ] All documentation links are correct and examples work
- [ ] SonarQube (or similar) analysis shows >80% code coverage (if applicable)
- [ ] No open critical bugs in milestone

## 📎 Dependencies
- All previous milestones (v0.0.0 → v0.9.0) must be **closed**

## 🧪 Validation Checklist
- [ ] `./scripts/pom-validator.sh --strict` passes
- [ ] `mvn clean verify` completes on all three browsers
- [ ] Allure report generated in CI and attached to release
- [ ] `release-pr.sh` dry‑run produces correct version bump
- [ ] Manual review of README by another team member
